name: VideoSpace
tagline: Local-first nonlinear video editing with GPU composition in-browser
summary: VideoSpace is a nonlinear video editor running as a real Uno WebAssembly and native desktop app, built on a frame-addressed C# editing engine, reusable custom controls and a local browser media pipeline. It supports transitions, editable nested sequences, multicamera sources and offline VP8/VP9 + Opus WebM export, all without a media upload service. The engine ships as ten packable libraries, six of which do not depend on Uno.

highlights.title: Real NLE editing
highlights.text: Razor, trim, guarded ripple, roll, slip, rate stretch, insert/overwrite and linked selection, with invalid edits rolled back atomically.

highlights.title: Transitions with real handles
highlights.text: Cross dissolve, dips to black/white, directional wipes and audio crossfades with centered, start or end-at-cut alignment.

highlights.title: Editable nested sequences
highlights.text: Nest a selection and keep its tracks, effects, transitions, captions, markers and audio editable, with guarded unnesting.

highlights.title: Multicamera cuts
highlights.text: Combine 2–16 manually offset sources and cut between angles with keys 1–9 or Effect Controls.

highlights.title: GPU composition
highlights.text: Hardware WebGPU preferred, WebGL2 fallback and reduced Canvas preview, with nested sequences and transitions rendered in one context.

highlights.title: Offline WebM export
highlights.text: Offline export to VP9/VP8 + Opus WebM that renders every output frame, with explicit frame timestamps and sample-clock stereo audio.

highlights.title: Keyframed effects
highlights.text: Effect Controls with typed or scrubbed values, keyframe diamonds, editable color presets and curves that survive split and trim.

highlights.title: Local-first by design
highlights.text: Media stays on your device: IndexedDB recovery in the browser and portable .videospace manifests, no upload service.

codeSamples.title: Build, test and publish for the browser
codeSamples.code:
git clone https://github.com/wieslawsoltes/VideoSpace.git
cd VideoSpace
python3 scripts/fetch-assets.py
dotnet run --project tests/VideoSpace.Tests -c Release
dotnet run --project tests/VideoSpace.Parity.Tests -c Release

dotnet workload install wasm-tools --skip-manifest-update
dotnet publish src/VideoSpace.App -f net10.0-browserwasm -c Release \
  -o artifacts/publish -p:WasmShellWebAppBasePath=/VideoSpace/
python3 scripts/collect-site.py artifacts/publish artifacts/site
python3 scripts/serve-site.py --directory artifacts/site --port 4173

shortcuts.action: Selection / razor / ripple / roll / slip / stretch / hand
shortcuts.keys: V / C / B / N / Y / R / H

playground.intro: The browser editor opens the original NORTH sample with generated landscapes, titles, synthesized audio, markers and captions ready to edit.

tour.title: Play NORTH
tour.text: Press Space to play the sample and click the timeline ruler to seek.

tour.title: Trim and cut
tour.text: Press C to razor a clip, then use B, N or Y to ripple, roll or slip an edit point.

tour.title: Add a transition
tour.text: Select the outgoing clip at a cut and choose Clip → Add / edit transition to add a dissolve, dip or wipe.

tour.title: Import your own media
tour.text: Import or drop local files, select an asset to open Source, mark In/Out and press comma or period to insert or overwrite.

tour.title: Nest a sequence
tour.text: Select every clip in a range and choose Sequence → Nest selection, then open the nested sequence to edit inside it.

tour.title: Save and export
tour.text: Save a .videospace manifest, capture a PNG frame, or export an offline WebM movie.

architecture.name: Model and documents
architecture.text: Frame-based project model with rational time and prepared indexes, plus validated manifests, SRT and EDL.

architecture.name: Engine
architecture.text: Transactional editing, timeline geometry, prepared frame plans and sample-clock audio mixing, all without Uno.

architecture.name: Rendering and media
architecture.text: Skia composition on native hosts and a single-context WebGPU/WebGL2 graph with WebM indexing and codecs in the browser.

architecture.name: Controls and workbench
architecture.text: Custom Uno timeline, monitors and bins composed into an embeddable editing workspace.

boundaries: Implemented NLE subset, not complete or pixel-identical Adobe Premiere Pro parity
Native desktop lacks imported video/audio playback, video export and live audio output
No automatic multicam sync or simultaneous angle grid; no .prproj/AAF/Final Cut XML interchange
Export is limited to a ten-minute range with explicit memory budgets; arbitrary VFR accuracy not claimed
Saved manifests omit media bytes; IndexedDB recovery is quota-dependent and not a backup
